_comment: Pinned copy of the Document Engine's INCOME document types, taken from the engine's consumer contract section 5 (Coverage). This is the reader side of the same gate the engine runs against its own migrations (ConsumerCoverageTableIT). Refresh it with tools/engine-goldens/refresh_income_types.py whenever the engine pin moves; EngineIncomeTypeCoverageTest fails when the engine serves an INCOME type the Income Lab does not accept.
